onset.Description: Position of event marker in seconds relative to the start.

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds.

sample.Description: Time of the event in samples, counted from the start of the recording at the sampling frequency given in the EEG sidecar (1100 Hz). Equals onset multiplied by the sampling frequency, without rounding, so it can be fractional.

event_type.Description: The main category of the event.

Levels.show_face: Display a face to mark end of pre-stimulus and start of blink-inhibition.
Levels.show_face_initial: Display a face at the beginning of the recording.
Levels.show_circle: Display a white circle to mark end of the stimulus and blink inhibition.
Levels.show_cross: Display only a white cross to mark start of trial and fixation.
Levels.left_press: Experiment participant presses a key with left index finger.
Levels.right_press: Experiment participant presses a key with right index finger.
Levels.setup_left_sym: Setup for experiment with pressing key with left index finger means a face with above average symmetry.
Levels.setup_right_sym: Setup for experiment with pressing key with right index finger means a face with above average symmetry.

HED.show_circle: Sensory-event, (Intended-effect, Cue), (Def/Circle-only, Onset), (Def/Face-image, Offset), (Def/Blink-inhibition-task, Offset), (Def/Fixation-task, Offset), {trial}

face_type.Description: Factor indicating type of face image being displayed.

Levels.famous_face: A face that should be recognized by the participants.
Levels.unfamiliar_face: A face that should not be recognized by the participants.
Levels.scrambled_face: A scrambled face image generated by taking face 2D FFT.

rep_status.Description: Factor indicating whether this image has been already seen.

Levels.first_show: Factor level indicating the first display of this face.
Levels.immediate_repeat: Factor level indicating this face was the same as previous one.
Levels.delayed_repeat: Factor level indicating face was seen 6 to 16 trials ago.

trial.Description: Indicates which trial this event belongs to. A press is labelled with the trial whose fixation cross came before it. In 32 presses the press comes after the fixation cross of a trial but before that trial's face, so it follows the face of the previous trial; these are likely late responses to the previous trial, inferred from timing and not recorded.

rep_lag.Description: How face images before this one was the image was previously presented.

stim_file.Description: Path of the stimulus file in the stimuli directory.

hed_def_sensory.Description: Metadata dictionary for gathering sensory definitions

HED.face_image_def: (Definition/Face-image, (Visual-presentation, (Foreground-view, ((Image, Face, Hair), Color/Grayscale), ((White, Cross), (Center-of, Computer-screen))), (Background-view, Black), Description/A happy or neutral face in frontal or three-quarters frontal pose with long hair cropped presented as an achromatic foreground image on a black background with a white fixation cross superposed.))
HED.circle_only_def: (Definition/Circle-only, (Visual-presentation, (Foreground-view, ((White, Circle), (Center-of, Computer-screen))), (Background-view, Black), Description/A white circle on a black background in the center of the screen.))

hed_def_setup.Description: Metadata dictionary for gathering setup definitions

Levels.0: Disappearance of face image and display of the inter-stimulus circle simultaneously
Levels.1: Display only a white cross to mark start of trial and fixation.
Levels.2: Initial presentation of famous face at the beginning of the recording
Levels.3: Initial presentation of unfamiliar face at the beginning of the recording
Levels.4: Initial presentation of scrambled face at the beginning of the recording
Levels.6: Immediate repeated  presentation of famous face
Levels.7: Delayed repeated  presentation of famous face
Levels.14: Immediate repeated  presentation of unfamiliar face
Levels.15: Delayed repeated  presentation of unfamiliar face
Levels.18: Immediate repeated  presentation of scrambled face
Levels.19: Delayed repeated  presentation of scrambled face
Levels.101: Setup for experiment with pressing key with left index finger means a face with above average symmetry.
Levels.102: Setup for experiment with pressing key with right index finger means a face with above average symmetry.
Levels.4352: Left and right finger key presses
